controls.name: Dual approval for high-value transactions
controls.description: Any approved card transaction above Rs. 2,00,000 must carry two distinct approvers before settlement.
controls.risk: Unauthorised or fraudulent high-value spend is settled without independent review.

controls.name: Segregation of duties - initiator vs approver
controls.description: The employee who initiates a transaction may not approve the same transaction.
controls.risk: A single person can initiate and approve a transaction, enabling fraud or error to go undetected.

controls.name: Credit limit breach block
controls.description: Authorisation is declined when balance plus transaction amount would exceed the card credit limit.
controls.risk: Customers are extended credit beyond approved limits, increasing credit loss exposure.

controls.name: Duplicate transaction detection (60 seconds)
controls.description: Transactions on the same card, at the same merchant, for the same amount within 60 seconds are flagged and reversed.
controls.risk: Customers are charged twice for one purchase, causing financial loss and complaints.
